blocks.text: Stacks manage function calls. Imagine making a series of phone calls: each time you call someone you write the name on top of a notepad (push), and when the call ends you cross it off (pop). In programming, when a function is called its details, such as what it must do and where to return afterwards, are pushed onto the call stack; when it finishes they are popped, so the computer knows what to do next.
